title: PIXL Nic Salts Fresh Mint 10ml E-Liquid
description: A clean and refreshing all-day flavour. This evokes the sweet, punchy and aromatic notes of garden-fresh peppermint with a light, cooling exhale. PIXL Nic Salts are crafted with a 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, making them ideal for use in low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape kits, such as refillable pod systems and starter kits . This balanced blend ensures a smooth throat hit, discreet vapour production, and excellent flavour delivery. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these 10ml e-liquids use nicotine salts to provide a smoother, more immediate form of nicotine satisfaction compared to traditional freebase nicotine. They are the perfect choice for vapers seeking a satisfying, flavour-packed experience.This premium e-liquid is part of the PIXL Nic Salt collection, a range from the brand that created the popular PIXL prefilled pod kit. This collection is dedicated to crafting bold, clear, and satisfying flavours, all formulated as 10ml nic salts.
